turn 2: src/main.rs was emitted more than once. Two blocks for one path means the last one silently wins, and which one was meant is unknowable. Refused.

Terminated mid-round by the proctor. The sandbox image rust:1.88-slim has no rustfmt component, so `cargo fmt` exited 1 with "'cargo-fmt' is not installed" for every input. Freezing requires fmt to exit 0, so no candidate in this image could ever have been freeze-ready: the round was unwinnable by construction. It was stopped rather than run to exhaustion because the feedback channel was carrying the model a compiler error it could not fix, which corrupts the measurement more than terminating does.
